description: Use when an agent must see who an EVM wallet deals with: counterparties ranked by ERC-20 transfers, earliest inbound sender, wallets the same EOA funder also paid, tokens moved. Input: address, chain (base default, ethereum, arbitrum, monad), hours (1-24, Arbitrum 1-6, Monad 1-2; default 6), limit. Output: JSON counterparties with own labels (contract/EOA, known token), first and shared funder. ERC-20 only. Example: ?address=0xd0b53D9277642d899DF5C87A3966A349A798F224 Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: Wallet (or contract) on the chosen chain (example: Uniswap v3 WETH/USDC pool on Base, a busy contract; a quiet wallet returns 0 transfers, not an error)

hours.description: Look-back in hours (default 6; max 24, Arbitrum max 6, Monad max 2 and default 2)

name: base_wallet_related
title: Wallet relations on Base, Ethereum or Arbitrum: counterparties, first funder in window, shared-funder hints
